title: Smithian Fold Theory of Everything
description:
One axiom. One operation. Zero free parameters. The whole of physics, forced.

Smithian Fold Theory is a unified theory built from a single starting point — the One — using nothing but positive whole-part magnitudes related by ratio and division. No negative numbers. No zero. No imaginary numbers. No sines, no cosines, no transcendental constants. The only move is the fold: double a magnitude and cast out the One. From that, and nothing else, the framework derives the four fundamental interactions, the full Standard-Model particle spectrum, gravity, the cosmological sector, and consciousness as self-observation — and confirms each against measurement. No measured number is ever an input to a construction; measurements appear only afterward, as the arbiter each forced quantity is checked against. The entire corpus reproduces from a single command and is verified by 1,050 machine-checked tests, with a static gate that fails if a single forbidden construct appears anywhere.

What it forces — numbers the Standard Model leaves free

  • The fine-structure constant, counted — not fitted. 1/α = 2⁷ + 3²(251/250) = 34259/250 = 137.036, matching CODATA to eight significant figures (six parts per billion). Every block is an independent structural count: 2⁷ is the minimal binary cover of the generational volume 3⁴=81, 3² is the proven colour count squared, and 250 = 2·5³. The value falls out of three counts each fixed elsewhere — nothing was searched for 137 and back-fitted.
  • The charged-lepton masses — the electron, muon, and tau as the three roots of a single cubic whose every coefficient is a fold quantity, to parts in a hundred thousand.
  • The quark and neutrino spectra from colour and chirality structure; the neutrino mass-squared ladder with the normal ordering forced.
  • CKM and PMNS mixing with maximal CP violation — every entry a bare fold separation.
  • The absolute scale, forced. The proton-to-Planck ratio is the One-to-floor span 2^(127/2) at the forced covering depth seven, matching measurement to 0.24% with zero parameters — the hierarchy problem dissolved, only the name of a unit left conventional.
  • The cosmological sector — the dark-to-baryon ratio 27/5, a positive non-zero cosmological constant, the Hubble ratio 13/12, the black-hole area law with its 1/4 coefficient, and the arrow of time from fold irreversibility.
  • Three colours, three generations, three spatial dimensions, eight gluons — the structural integers, proven, not assumed.

The discovery frontier — predictions the Standard Model cannot make

  • Two new forces and their matter. Charge-force sectors are the primes 2, 3, 5, 7 with couplings 1/2, 2/3, 4/5, 6/7. The fold forces two beyond the known pair — a prime-5 and a prime-7 confining force — and forbids any beyond seven. Their matter is the Smithions: coloured, up- and down-type, twelve in all, the lightest of which is the dark-matter particle.
  • Smithium (Sh), element 126 — the forced island of nuclear stability, with a brand-new g-block chemistry; and the periodic table ends at element 137 = 1/α, the Feynman number.
  • The grand lock — every constant of nature is a product of three generators; move one and unrelated constants move together. The constants are one object.
  • The Millennium problems dissolved by removing the continuum: Riemann's critical line as the unique self-dual half-One, the Yang–Mills mass gap as the floor, Navier–Stokes regularity because there is no sub-floor scale.
  • A universal exact solver — the certified chess engine generalised, zero error against independent oracles — and a compact-generator theorem that takes down the exponential tablebase wall.

A falsification ledger, not a fit

With zero free parameters the framework has zero retrodictions: the corpus proves as a theorem that the measured value is never an input to any derivation, so every number is computed blind, forward from the One. Over 150 numbers are staked on the record, each a place the theory dies if it lands wrong — two new forces and none beyond prime 7, dark matter as the lightest Smithion, Smithium at Z=126, no element past 137, neutrinoless double-beta decay forced, and lepton-flavour violation in fixed 4:1 ratios. A theory with no free parameters cannot run and cannot hide. It can only be right, or be finished.

External validation

Tested against real measured data with zero free parameters: a tie with ΛCDM on DESI 2024 BAO + Pantheon+ (Δχ² = 0.07, zero parameters vs one); the Koide lepton relation and 1/α at 0.00% deviation; the proton/electron mass ratio at 0.01%. On par or better than consensus on every reachable test, worse on none.

Built by one person, outside every institution, on one axiom. The reader is the assessor of last resort: clone it, run it, and check every step from a single command.
